Chicago Metal Fabrication · Since 1929

Steel that holds up the city.

David Architectural Metals Inc is a family firm tracing to 1929. From monumental stairs to structural steel, the shop fabricates the metalwork buildings are built around — for developers, contractors, and project teams putting a bid together.

A Family Firm

Nearly a century in Chicago metal

The firm's history, as told on its own site — no embellishment added.

1929

David Iron Works

The family firm traces its roots to 1929, when it began as David Iron Works.

1945

A New Name

In 1945, the firm was renamed David Architectural Metals, Inc. — the name it carries today.
